info.title: Frontify
info.description: Work with your Frontify brand assets, libraries, and account through the Frontify GraphQL API. Each operation takes a simple JSON body and returns clean JSON - the connector builds the GraphQL request for you. Includes a generic Run Query operation for anything not covered by the typed operations.

post.description: Add assets to a collection. The assets must be in the same library as the collection. Requires the basic:write scope.

post.description: Add custom metadata values to one or more assets or workspace projects. Requires the basic:write scope.

200.description: The parent IDs that were updated

post.description: Retrieve a single asset by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the asset to retrieve.

post.description: Upload a file and create an asset from it in one step: reserves a file ID, uploads the bytes to the presigned URLs, then creates the asset. Requires the basic:write scope. The file is provided as base64 content.

filename.description: The file name including extension (for example logo.png).

content.description: The file contents as a base64-encoded string.

title.description: The title (display name) of the new asset.

parentId.description: The library, workspace project, or folder ID to place the asset in.

externalId.description: An optional external ID for the asset.

author.description: An optional author (for example a photographer name).

tags.description: Optional tags to create with the asset.

assetId.description: The ID of the newly created asset.

fileId.description: The signed file ID that was uploaded.

title.description: The title of the created asset.

post.description: Retrieve the user the API token belongs to.
Update an existing asset. Requires the basic:write scope and EDIT permission on the asset.

id.description: The ID of the asset to update.

data.description: The fields to update (a Frontify UpdateAssetDataInput object).

post.description: Add one or more tags to an asset. Requires the basic:write scope and EDIT permission on the asset.

id.description: The ID of the asset to tag.

post.description: Delete an asset by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the asset to delete.
The ID of the deleted asset.

post.description: Run any Frontify GraphQL query or mutation. Provide the GraphQL document and optional variables; the raw data object is returned.

query.description: The GraphQL query or mutation document.

variables.description: Variables referenced by the query document.

operationName.description: The operation name to run when the document defines several.

status.description: The asset conversion status (for example FINISHED).

externalId.description: The external ID of the asset.

author.description: The author of the asset (for example a photographer name).

modifiedAt.description: When the asset was last modified.

isRequired.description: Whether the property must be defined.

assetType.description: The concrete asset type (Image, Document, File, Video, or Audio).

downloadUrl.description: Signed URL to download the original file. Null if download-protected.

api_key.name: Authorization
api_key.description: Your Frontify API token. Create one in your Frontify instance under Settings > API tokens. Enter just the token value; the connector adds the 'Bearer ' prefix automatically.
